dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical 2D narrowing of the visible body mass from the mid-back toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey median tone; consistent with a sub-adult or transitioning individual.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slopes between the light-grey base and the darker mottled clusters.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of fine, linear high-contrast white marks on the upper dorsal surface and one distinct white spot on the lower right quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Healed linear white markings consistent with rake marks across the dorsal plane; one distinct small white patch on the posterior right flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Sharply defined longitudinal dorsal ridge casting a subtle shadow on the left-hand side of the midline.
